passage:
The city fountain was turned off during a water shortage. Some residents complained that the square looked less beautiful.
A student wrote an article explaining how much water the fountain used and why the city had made the decision. She also interviewed shop owners and families affected by water limits.
After reading the article, some residents changed their opinions. They still missed the fountain, but they understood the reason.
The dry fountain became a symbol of shared sacrifice.
Beauty matters in public spaces, but during shortage, priorities change. A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.
